newsitem.title: USA: CUC Intl in pact with Mitsubishi, Uny.
newsitem.headline: CUC Intl in pact with Mitsubishi, Uny.

text.p: CUC International Inc said on Monday it renegotiated its Japanese license, acquiring a 40 percent equity ownership in CUC Japan, a joint venture also owned by Mitsubishi Corp and some of its affiliates and Uny Corp.

The joint venture would market CUC's individual, wholesale and interactive membership services to the Japanese consumer market, CUC said. It would be based in Tokyo and CUC said it would be responsible for managing the company.

Walter Forbes, chairman and chief executive officer of CUC International, said: "CUC provides marketing talent and consumer service expertise. Mitsubishi contributes an extensive network of banking and other business partners, while Uny offers a leading market position in the retailing industry."
CUC was not immediately available to comment further on the venture.
